candidates.label: A
candidates.notes: All table values and labels match the image. Page number and sidebar (ユニット6 働くということ) included. Second table's two-level header is flattened into '全体 11年卒' style columns, which is a reasonable and unambiguous rendering.

candidates.label: B
candidates.notes: All data correct. Sidebar is transcribed but placed at the end of the page. Second table header repeats a bare '11年卒' after each group, which is faithful but slightly ambiguous. Page number bolded.

candidates.label: C
candidates.notes: Sidebar has a typo: '働くということこ' with an extra こ. Table data is all correct. The two-row header for table ③ is the closest to the original layout.

candidates.label: D
candidates.notes: All content correct, sidebar included. Uses ## headings for the question lines, a minor stylistic addition. Flattened header ('全体 11年卒') is the same as A's and acceptable.

candidates.label: E
candidates.notes: Omits the sidebar entirely (ユニット 6 働くということ). Invents '(2012年卒)' labels in the table ③ header that are not in the image, and adds parentheses around 11年卒. Cell data is correct.

rationale: All five candidates transcribe the numeric data in both tables correctly, so the ranking turns on the sidebar, header handling and invented text. A and D are complete and accurate with a sensible flattened header; A is slightly cleaner because D adds heading markup. B is accurate but moves the sidebar to the end and leaves the sub-header ambiguous. C has the most faithful two-row header but a character error in the sidebar ('ということこ'). E is last because it drops the sidebar and fabricates '(2012年卒)' column labels.
